About.Heading: Who We Are
Paragraphs: At Vardhaman Classes, we believe every child has the potential to excel with the right guidance. Located at Maharshi Nagar, near Gultekdi, Pune, we are a trusted coaching institute offering structured and result-oriented learning for Classes 1 through 10 across CBSE, ICSE and SSC boards.

Our teaching approach goes beyond the textbook. We focus on conceptual clarity, consistent practice and building a student's confidence alongside their academic performance. At Vardhaman Classes, students don't just prepare for exams. They develop a genuine love for learning.

Items.Name: Shweta Jain
Items.Bio: A concept-first approach that transforms how students think and solve problems. Known for patience and simplifying complex topics, she builds strong foundations and better exam results.

Items.Name: Vandana Mutha
Items.Bio: Makes Social Studies and Languages engaging through storytelling and real-world connections. Students build lasting reading, writing, and communication skills under her guidance.

Items.Name: Ayesha Shaikh
Items.Bio: Nurtures young learners from Standards 1 to 7 with a patient, interactive style. Focused on individual attention so children grow confidence and a love for learning early on.

Items.Title: All Three Boards Under One Roof
Items.Body: Whether your child is in CBSE, ICSE or SSC, Vardhaman Classes covers it all with equal depth and expertise.

Items.Title: Dedicated Subject Experts
Items.Body: Our teachers are specialists in their subjects, not generalists. This means deeper understanding and better results for every student.

Items.Title: Small Batch Sizes
Items.Body: We keep our batches intentionally small so every student receives personal attention and no doubt goes unaddressed.

Items.Title: Regular Tests and Assessments
Items.Body: Students are assessed consistently through chapter tests, unit tests and full mock exams so they are always exam-ready.

Items.Title: Daily Doubt Sessions
Items.Body: Every student has access to dedicated doubt-clearing sessions so learning never gets stuck.

Items.Title: Conveniently Located
Items.Body: Our institute is easily accessible at Maharshi Nagar, near Gultekdi, Pune.

Courses.Heading: Batches for every grade, every board

Batches.Title: Primary Batches
Batches.Body: We build strong academic foundations in Mathematics, Languages, Environmental Science and General Knowledge. Learning at this stage is made interactive, age-appropriate and enjoyable so students develop a positive relationship with education from the very beginning.

Batches.Title: Middle School Batches
Batches.Body: Concepts deepen at this stage and so does our approach. Our structured program covers all subjects across CBSE, ICSE and SSC with special attention given to Mathematics and Science where students often begin to struggle.

Batches.Title: Board Exam Batches
Batches.Body: Board exam preparation done right. We offer focused chapter-wise revision, regular full-length mock tests, performance tracking and intensive one-on-one doubt sessions. Our goal is simple: every student walks into their board exam with complete preparation and full confidence.

Items.Text: Shweta Ma'am's way of teaching Maths completely changed how my son approaches the subject. He went from struggling to scoring 92 in his SSC boards.
Items.Author: Parent of a Class 10 Student

Items.Text: Vandana Ma'am makes History feel like a story. My daughter actually looks forward to Social Studies now, which I never thought I would say.
Items.Author: Parent of a Class 8 Student

Items.Text: The small batch size is what made the difference for us. The teachers genuinely know where each child is and what they need.
Items.Author: Parent of a Class 6 Student
